name: PingMe
description: Example/tutorial module demonstrating schema, mail, CRUD, record lists, single-record view and modal-popup forms for a simple message table.
project_description:
This module basically designed for new drupal members to learn about customization of module development.

 Path : /ping-me/records

All operations could be done from mentioned path.

 Features : 

1. Schema

2. Curd Operations with Ajax.

3. Modal Popup

4. Record List

5. Custom Drupal Mail Feature.

 NOTE : Mail feature is Commented in ChatForm if anybody want mail functionality then simply uncomment the code and rebuilt drupal cache it will work nicely.
